title: Yellowed Crunchy Polish Beef Tacos
description: A hearty Polish dish featuring marinated beef, served in hard taco shells with a blend of cheeses and earthy flavors, perfect for a hangover cure.
instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together mushroom broth, onion powder, and garlic powder to create the marinade.
Add the ground beef to the marinade and mix until just combined, being careful not to overmix.
Cover the bowl with plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least 2 hours or overnight.
Preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat and cook the marinated beef until browned, breaking it up into small pieces as it cooks.
Reduce heat to low and simmer the beef for 10 minutes, stirring occasionally.
While the beef is cooking, prepare the taco shells according to package instructions.
Assemble the tacos by spooning the beef mixture into the shells, followed by a sprinkle of shredded cheddar cheese.
Place the tacos under the broiler for 2-3 minutes, or until the cheese is melted and bubbly.
Remove the tacos from the oven and top each one with a dollop of sour cream, a sprinkle of diced yellow onion, and a sprinkle of chopped fresh parsley.
